title: Gemini CLI
content: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal. Built in Go, designed for developers who live in the command line.

title: The Problem
content: Context switching between the editor and AI chat breaks flow. Every file lookup, every code question costs a context switch. Developers need intelligence where they already work.

title: Architecture
content: CLI → Planner → Tool Executor → Models. The planner decomposes tasks into atomic tool calls. Each tool is isolated and composable. The core runtime never changes — only skills grow.

title: The Solution
content: Gemini CLI acts as a local agent with full filesystem access. It reads context, plans changes, executes tools, and streams feedback — all without leaving the terminal.

title: Stack
content: Go for performance and single-binary distribution. Gemini API for multimodal reasoning. Streaming output for instant feedback. Modular skill system for extensibility.

title: Roadmap
content: Parallel subagents. Long-term contextual memory. Screenshot support via multimodal Gemini. Plugin marketplace for community skills.
